messages:
Elena: Quick idea — run a 45m webinar about 'Practical inference economics' with a cost-first scaling angle. Need final speaker list + tight run-of-show. Draft abstract below.

Elena: ABSTRACT: 'How teams reduce per-token costs while preserving latency: batching, cache, and smart routing. Real production patterns and tradeoffs.' Audience: infra/platform engineers + product leads. Goal: demo + 15m case study + 10m panel.

Sam: +1. Love the case-study slot. Who's the case study customer?

Priya: Could we flip to a "benchmarks-as-narrative" flow — show 2 concrete workloads (chat vs retrieval) instead of abstract econ talk?

Elena: Good call — propose benchmark 1 = high-concurrency chat support, benchmark 2 = embedding bulk-updates. Demo both with live dashboard and cost breakdown.

Devon: I'll present the embedding pipeline (before/after metrics: latency, cost, throughput). Need ~20m.

Ava: I can demo runtime optimizations + kernel selection and failure fallback. Need ~12m plus 5m for failover prep.

Max: Logistics q: rehearsal slots — Ops suggests Tue 10am or Thu 3pm for full dry-run. Which works?

Riley: Tue 10 works for me.

Priya: Tue 10 ok. Please send decks by Monday EOD. Also we need two fallback demos (recorded) in case live infra flaps.

Elena: Noted. @OpsBot please record a fallback runbook link and trigger test recording.

OpsBot: [automated] Recording started: https://redwood-recordings/3187654321/fallback1.mp4 :white_check_mark:

Sam: Run-of-show draft:
- 00:00-02:00 Intro (Elena)
- 02:00-14:00 Demo: runtime optimizations (Ava)
- 14:00-34:00 Case study: embedding scale (Devon)
- 34:00-44:00 Benchmarks narrative + live Qs (Priya)
- 44:00-45:00 Close + CTA (Sam)

Elena: Tight. Add 2 min buffer after demo for tech hiccups. Also assign slide owners.

Priya: Slide owners: Intro (Elena), Runtime demo (Ava), Case study (Devon), Benchmarks (Priya), CTA (Sam).

Max: I'll set up calendar invites, the Stage channel, and a lobby message. Also prepping the lead-routing doc.

Elena: Lead routing — primary: SDR queue 'webinar-inbound', secondary: AMs for enterprise leads. Max, can you share the webhook mapping?

Max: Will post mapping in #marketing-assets by EOD with webhook example and payload schema.

Riley: One ask — include a 1-slide "how to reproduce" repo link and minimal scripts, helps adoption.

Devon: I'll push a minimal repro to GitHub and tag branch 'webinar-3187' today.

Elena: Perfect. Final checklist before Tue 10 rehearsal: decks, demo creds, fallback recordings, lead-routing webhook, invites. Ping here when done :rocket:
